row: Northern Lights Wildlife Society is located in Smithers, BC, Canada and rehabilitates injured and/or orphaned wildlife until it can be returned to the wild. We rewild all native mammals and act as a triage center for birds. We specialize in bears (both black bears and grizzly) and other large mammals. NLWS is primarily operated by volunteers and is not open to public viewing.  We are funded by public donations and licenced by the BC Government since 1990.
